study.title: ResLMFFNet: a real-time semantic segmentation network for precision agriculture

mIoU.ambiguity: Paper reports IoU/F1 per dataset; values 0.681/0.781 taken from the UAV wheat yellow-rust experiment.

issues: Real-time claim evidenced on desktop hardware only: 97.86 FPS measured on a Quadro RTX 5000 workstation (1.34 M params, 12.73 GFLOPs); not an edge/on-device benchmark, so edge metrics remain unreported.

mIoU.quote: this study demonstrates a significant enhancement in the mIoU for straw segmentation by incorporating the VGG19 network and CBAM into the architecture, resulting in an impressive increase of 9.69 percentage points to reach 83.23%

PA.quote: Experimental results prove that our algorithm achieves 93.87% accuracy in segmenting and extracting corn stalks from images with complex backgrounds
PA.ambiguity: Reported as overall 'accuracy' (93.87%) alongside mIoU 83.23% in the comparison table; per-pixel segmentation accuracy treated as PA.

issues: Only mIoU and an overall accuracy metric reported. No edge/on-device inference benchmark.

dataset.note: Segmentation reformulated as coordinate-to-text prediction; prompts for general object segmentation and crop-specific segmentation.

mIoU.quote: Qwen2- VL-7B achieved the highest overall performance with an F1- score of 0.4916 and IoU of 0.4661, demonstrating superior capability in adapting to the coordinate-based segmentation task
mIoU.ambiguity: IoU (0.4661) reported under VLM coordinate-to-text reformulation of segmentation; treated as mIoU.

F1.quote: Qwen2- VL-7B achieved the highest overall performance with an F1- score of 0.4916 and IoU of 0.4661
F1.ambiguity: Overall F1 across crops (corn, barley, tobacco) for the coordinate-based task.

crop_F1.quote: all models exhibited substantially better performance on tobacco segmentation compared to corn and barley, with Qwen2-VL-7B achieving an impressive F1-score of 0.7842 for tobacco identification
crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-crop F1 for tobacco only (0.7842); crop_F1 recorded for the single best-mapped crop.

issues: Segmentation cast as coordinate-to-text prediction, so no pixel-wise PA/Dice/mPA; corpus is VLMs with no on-device/edge inference benchmark.

dataset.name: AgriAdapt (self-collected salad crop aerial images with weeds)
dataset.note: 643 (abstract) to 747 (dataset section) images reported; 1280 x 1280 px source imagery; GSD 0.4 cm.

mIoU.quote: It achieves an IoU of 55.45 and an accuracy of 89.84%
mIoU.ambiguity: Paper reports a single IoU (55.45%) for the weed/background task; treated as mIoU. LRASPP reaches a higher IoU (59.25%) at much lower speed.

F1.ambiguity: F1-score (69.68%) from Table 4 row for Squeeze U-Net at 512 x 512 input.

PA.quote: It achieves an IoU of 55.45 and an accuracy of 89.84%
PA.ambiguity: Paper defines Accuracy as overall pixel-level accuracy (OA = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FN+FP), Eq. 2) - mapped to PA.

fps.quote: the measured inference times correspond to average frame rates of 30.6 FPS for Squeeze U-Net, 18.8 FPS for LRASPP, and 17.7 FPS for DeepLabV3

latency_ms.quote: On average, Squeeze U-Net required only 0.0327 s per image, which is nearly 40% faster than LRASPP (0.0532 s)

power_w.quote: our Squeeze U-Net achieves 30.6 FPS directly on the lower-power Jetson Nano (5-10 W) with 55.45 mIoU and 89.8% accuracy
power_w.ambiguity: 5-10 W quoted for the Jetson Nano platform envelope in the comparison discussion; not a model-specific power measurement.

params_M.quote: the most parameter-efficient model with 2.5 million parameters and 6.6 GFLOPS

gflops.quote: the most parameter-efficient model with 2.5 million parameters and 6.6 GFLOPS

issues: Best edge model is Squeeze U-Net at 512 x 512; LRASPP achieves higher IoU (59.25%) but only 18.8 FPS. Accuracy is defined as per-pixel overall accuracy in the paper, hence mapped to PA.

mIoU.quote: At 100% width, the SSU-Net achieved an IoU of 58.28%, surpassing the SU-Net's 57.13%
